title.zh: 从整体代码提升共同分解
title.en: Lifting a joint decomposition from a whole code

statement.en: The parts a description reads together lift from every configuration it describes exactly where configurations it identifies match parts into ones it identifies, with no premise; through a code reading the joint tests exactly and reducedly they lift where pairs of parts are compact and tests stable.
statement.zh: 一个描述合读的诸部分，从它所描述的每个构形提升，恰当它所认同的构形把部分匹配到它所认同的构形，不加前提；经由精确且约化地读出共同检验的编码，在部分之对紧致且检验稳定之处它们提升。

laws.en: A description reads the joint relation among descriptions where some configuration it so describes holds together parts it so describes; the parts lift from every configuration it describes where each pair read at that configuration's description is held together by the configuration with parts it describes alike.
laws.zh: 一个描述把共同关系读作描述之间的关系：凡有如此被描述的构形把如此被描述的部分合在一起。诸部分从它所描述的每个构形提升，是指在该构形的描述处所读的每对部分，都由该构形以它同样描述的部分合在一起。

laws.en: A relation matches parts where, for any two configurations it relates, each pair of parts the first holds together is matched by a pair the second holds together, related part by part. The parts lift through a description exactly where having one description matches parts, and, where it identifies exactly the configurations some relation relates, exactly where that relation matches parts; no premise.
laws.zh: 一个关系匹配部分，是指对它所关联的任意两个构形，前者合持的每对部分都有后者合持的一对与之逐部分相关。诸部分经一个描述提升，恰当具有同一描述匹配部分；它所认同的恰是某关系所关联的构形时，恰当该关系匹配部分；不加前提。

laws.en: Through a description identifying exactly the jointly alike configurations the parts lift, with no premise; through one identifying exactly the configurations passing the same joint tests they lift where the pairs of parts each configuration holds together are compact for pairs of joint tests and every joint test holds wherever it cannot fail.
laws.zh: 经由恰认同共同相似构形的描述，诸部分提升，不加前提；经由恰认同通过相同共同检验之构形的描述，在每个构形合持的部分之对对共同检验之对紧致、且每个共同检验在不可能不成立处成立时提升。

laws.en: Under the same two conditions, through a code reading the joint tests exactly and giving configurations passing the same joint tests one code, the parts lift from every configuration it describes, and configurations given one code match parts into configurations given one code.
laws.zh: 在同样两条下，经由精确读出共同检验、并给通过相同共同检验之构形同一编码的编码，诸部分从它所描述的每个构形提升，得同一编码的构形把部分匹配到得同一编码的构形。

laws.en: Excluded middle makes every joint test stable; and that configurations passing the same joint tests match parts into such configurations, in every joint frame with one move and one claim whose pairs of parts are compact, holds exactly under excluded middle, every proposition decided.
laws.zh: 排中律使每个共同检验稳定；而在每个只有一个动作与一个主张、部分之对紧致的共同框中，“通过相同共同检验的构形把部分匹配到这样的构形”恰在排中律（每个命题皆可判定）下成立。

hypotheses.zh: liftsFromEach_iff 与 IdentifiesJointAlike.lifts 不加前提。经共同检验与经编码的形式取 JointCompact（每个构形合持的部分之对对共同检验之对紧致）与 TestsStable（每个共同检验在不可能不成立处成立）；编码形式另取 Exact 与 Reduced。
hypotheses.en: No premise for liftsFromEach_iff and IdentifiesJointAlike.lifts. The forms through the joint tests and through a code take JointCompact (the pairs of parts each configuration holds together are compact for pairs of joint tests) and TestsStable (every joint test holds wherever it cannot fail); the code forms also take Exact and Reduced.

does_not_show.en: Lifting gives some parts described alike, not the substitution of designated parts or the duplication of support.
does_not_show.zh: 提升给出同样被描述的某些部分，不保证任意指定的部分可以替换，也不保证重复使用同一支持。

validation_scope.en: Machine-checked by the consolidated core checker: Becoming.Composition, Becoming.JointCorrespondence and Becoming.Likeness are bound to receipts in becoming/becoming-checks, and every cited declaration has an empty axiom report, excluded middle appearing in statements, never as an axiom. The periphery's earlier form (deeper/ExplanatoryJointness, its receipt in deeper/explanatory-jointness-checks) had one sufficient direction; it is a provenance reference.
validation_scope.zh: 合并核心检查器实查：Becoming.Composition、Becoming.JointCorrespondence 与 Becoming.Likeness 绑定 becoming/becoming-checks 中的回执，所引声明公理报告全空，排中律只出现在陈述中，不作为公理。外围的早先形式（deeper/ExplanatoryJointness，其回执在 deeper/explanatory-jointness-checks）只有一个充分方向；它为来源引用。

next_delta.en: Lift decompositions whose parts share or duplicate support, or whose designated parts must be substituted, with the conditions stated as hypotheses.
next_delta.zh: 提升部分共享或重复使用支持、或须替换指定部分的分解，其条件写为假设。

correspondence.zh: 整体、代码与成对关系的解释是给定的，不假设所有物理实现满足紧致性。
correspondence.en: The whole/code/joint interpretation is supplied; universal physical compactness is not assumed.

history.zh: 2026-10-14，整合 I3（Ren：“a lot proofs are probably not integrated”）：在脊柱上陈述，附加一个假设。新的核心模块 Becoming.Composition（只导入 Becoming.Likeness）加入一配置把两配置作为部分共同持有的关系（JointFrame），以及联合检验、联合相同、紧致、嵌套计划与足迹；Becoming.CompositionBridge 把 ExplanatoryJointness 与 ExplanatoryFootprints 读作实例。描述提升其所读之部分，恰当其所认同的配置把部分匹配到其所认同的配置（liftsFromEach_iff；外围只有一个充分方向）；若描述恰认同通过相同联合检验的配置，部分对紧致且检验稳定，则提升之（liftsFromEach_of_sameJointTests）。精确约化表示恰认同这些配置，codeJoint 即核心的 jointImage，所以在模型检验稳定处 code_joint_lifts_from_whole 在脊柱上成立（code_joint_lifts_from_whole_of_stable）；排中律给出稳定，无稳定时外围以经典方式所走的一步恰是排中律（matchesParts_of_compact_iff_em）。公理报告为空（草稿构建；回执随落地）。外围证明及其回执保持原范围；有限纤维无排中律是否紧致仍开放。
history.en: 14 October 2026, integration I3 (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”): stated on the spine, with one added hypothesis. The new core module Becoming.Composition, importing only Becoming.Likeness, adds the relation by which a configuration holds two configurations together as its parts (JointFrame), with joint tests, joint likeness, compactness, nested plans and footprints; Becoming.CompositionBridge reads ExplanatoryJointness and ExplanatoryFootprints as instances. A description lifts the parts it reads exactly where configurations it identifies match parts into configurations it identifies (liftsFromEach_iff; the periphery had one sufficient direction), and where it identifies exactly the configurations passing the same joint tests, the pairs of parts being compact and the tests stable, it lifts them (liftsFromEach_of_sameJointTests). An exact reduced presentation identifies exactly those configurations, and codeJoint is the core's jointImage, so code_joint_lifts_from_whole holds on the spine where the model's tests are stable (code_joint_lifts_from_whole_of_stable); excluded middle gives stability, and without stability the step the periphery takes classically is exactly excluded middle (matchesParts_of_compact_iff_em). Empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing). The periphery proof and its receipt keep their scope; whether finite fibres are compact without excluded middle is open.
